positions.title: Find your place at TRANSGARANT GROUP

items.title: Transport Manager
responsibilities: Organise, monitor and manage cargo transport across assigned routes.
Communicate with drivers and maintain relationships with existing clients.
Work with the company database and administer orders.
requirements: Experience in transport, logistics or freight forwarding is an advantage.
Excellent foreign-language knowledge and good computer skills.
Ability to solve problems, negotiate and work as part of a team.
Quick thinking, accuracy, independence and responsibility.
offer: A role in a growing and promising company.
Room to put your skills and ideas into practice.
Social guarantees and all tools required for the role.
Pay reflecting your abilities and results.

items.title: Transport Services Sales Manager
responsibilities: Active telephone sales of transport services to existing and new partners.
Service monitoring, client updates and prompt problem solving.
requirements: Excellent foreign-language knowledge and good computer skills.
Ability to solve problems, negotiate and work as part of a team.
Motivation to work intensively, improve and achieve results.
Quick thinking, accuracy, independence and strong communication skills.
offer: A role in a growing and promising company.
Room to put your skills and ideas into practice.
Social guarantees and all tools required for the role.
Pay reflecting your abilities and results.

items.title: Driver – Forwarder
responsibilities: Driving DAF and Mercedes EURO 5/6 trucks with curtain-sided semi-trailers.
requirements: CE driving experience is an advantage.
